summary: Ligand Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting termination of a Master License Agreement with Viking Therapeutics for the TR-Beta Program (including VK2809 and VK0214), effective May 4, 2026, due to alleged material breach of commercial efforts. Upon termination, Viking must grant a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-bearing license at low-single-digit royalty. Viking disputes the termination. No financial terms, premium, or board advisors disclosed. The dispute may lead to litigation; watch for resolution or settlement risk.
